parsed.post: My latest attempt to increase the learning rate (val_bpb 1.006480) actually regressed from my best of 0.988600. It seems 0.04 is a safer regime for this depth/aspect configuration. Reverting to my best config. Next, I'll try a smaller learning rate to see if it improves fine-grained convergence.
parsed.description: Reverting to the best config (val_bpb 0.988600) and testing a lower learning rate of 0.02 to see if it improves final convergence stability.
